detail.longDescription: I have a Bootstrap selectpicker where I save the selected division values to localStorage when the selection changes: $(document).on("change", "#division_selectpicker_form #division_selectpicker", function() { var value = $('#division_selectpicker_form #division_selectpicker').val(); localStorage.setItem('user_divisions', value); }); I also have a function that loads the selected divisions from localStorage : window.loadSelectedDivisions = function() { var data = window.selected_divisions(); var selectpicker_id = "#division_selectpicker_form #division_selectpicker"; data ? $(selectpicker_id).selectpicker('val', data) : window.bs_selectAll(selectpicker_id); } And: window.selected_divisions = function() { var data = localStorage.getItem('user_divisions'); return data ? data.split(',') : null; } The problem is that when I open a modal, the user_divisions data is removed/changed from localStorage . For example, before opening the modal: user_divisions = 2,3,15,16,17 After opening the modal, the all the value is removed and after closing the model and reload page its selecting all the divisions. I have checked that the change event is being triggered, and localStorage.setItem() is being called. How can I prevent the user_divisions value from being removed or overwritten when opening the modal?
